subject: pharmacology
title: Antitubercular Therapy: Isoniazid, Rifampicin, Pyrazinamide and Ethambutol

steps.tx: **Isoniazid**, a prodrug activated by mycobacterial KatG catalase peroxidase, blocks InhA in mycolic acid synthesis and kills dividing Mycobacterium tuberculosis bactericidally and cheaply, remaining the most potent early bactericidal drug and the backbone of latent infection therapy. Human genetics tax it twice: NAT2 acetylator status sets half life (slow acetylators accumulate neuropathy, fast acetylators underdose), and pyridoxine antagonism writes its signature adverse effect next lesson.
steps.say: Isoniazid is KatG activated mycolic acid sabotage; acetylator genetics set its speed and its neuropathy.

vis.alt: Tuberculosis infection progression diagram from latent infection to active disease
vis.caption: Tuberculosis progression from latent infection, the state isoniazid based preventive therapy treats.

steps.tx: **Rifampicin** binds bacterial RNA polymerase beta subunit and halts transcription, bactericidal against dividing and semi dormant persisters alike, which makes it tuberculosis' sterilising hero and the reason modern therapy lasts six rather than eighteen months. It stains urine, sweat and tears orange red (warn patients and contact lens wearers), and its hepatic enzyme induction is the most powerful in clinical medicine, gutting contraceptives, warfarin, antiretrovirals, transplant drugs and methadone within days.
steps.say: Rifampicin sterilises persisters and turns fluids orange while inducing half the formulary into failure.

vis.alt: DOTS tuberculosis treatment categories and regimen illustration
vis.caption: Directly observed tuberculosis regimens built on rifampicin and isoniazid backbones. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.tx: **Pyrazinamide**, activated by mycobacterial pyrazinamidase to pyrazinoic acid, kills semi dormant bacilli in acidic phagolysosomes where no other first line drug reaches, earning its place in the two month intensive phase and shortening therapy by sterilising that niche. Its bills are hepatotoxicity shared across the regimen and hyperuricaemia with arthralgia (inhibited urate excretion), while gout flares and liver enzymes are its monitoring pair.
steps.say: Pyrazinamide hunts bacilli hiding in acid; liver and uric acid pay its rent.

left.title: Intensive phase logic (2 months HRZE)
points: Isoniazid kills rapid dividers early
Rifampicin sterilises persisters throughout
Pyrazinamide clears acidic niche bacilli
Ethambutol guards against unrecognised resistance

right.title: Continuation phase (4 months HR)
points: Isoniazid and rifampicin continue
Pyrazinamide and ethambutol stop
Total six months for drug susceptible disease
Extensions for cavitation and slow response

steps.tx: **Ethambutol** inhibits arabinosyl transferases building the cell wall's arabinogalactan, bacteriostatic at ordinary doses, included not for killing power but as resistance insurance while susceptibilities are unknown. Its dose related optic toxicity next lesson defines it. Renal clearance demands dose adjustment in kidney impairment, where accumulation writes the visual casualties that baseline acuity and colour vision testing exist to pre empt.
steps.say: Ethambutol is the regimen's insurance policy; kidneys and eyes set its dose.

nodes.label: Baseline acuity and red green colour documented
Stops at 2 months when susceptibility confirmed

steps.tx: **Standard drug susceptible** therapy (two months isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide, ethambutol, then four months isoniazid and rifampicin) is combination therapy's resistance suppression doctrine from principles incarnate: spontaneous resistance mutations (about one in a million per drug) cannot survive four simultaneous locks. Fixed dose combinations, weight banding, directly observed or video observed therapy, and adherence support are therefore pharmacological interventions, not administrative garnish.
steps.say: Four drugs because one in a million bacilli already resists each; adherence systems are resistance policy.

left.title: Regimen architecture
points: Fixed dose combinations by weight band
Daily therapy preferred over intermittent
Pyridoxine with isoniazid in risk groups
Baseline liver, vision, HIV and diabetes screening

right.title: Support architecture
points: Observed or video observed therapy options
Adverse effect review at every visit
Contact tracing and infection control
Treatment literacy in the patient's language

steps.tx: **Rifampicin's induction demands** a medication reconciliation ritual at start and stop: hormonal contraception replaced or supplemented, warfarin doses multiplied then divided again two weeks after cessation (the rebound direction kills quietly), antiretroviral regimens rebuilt around rifabutin where protease inhibitors rule, transplant immunosuppression re levelled, and methadone withdrawal anticipated with dose increases that must be unwound at therapy's end.
steps.say: Reconcile every drug at rifampicin's arrival and again at its departure; the second reconciliation is the forgotten one.

nodes.label: Contraception, warfarin, ARVs and methadone adjusted
Rifampicin stopped: induction wanes over 2 weeks
Victim doses restored before toxicity rebounds

steps.tx: **Latent tuberculosis therapy** trades duration against hepatotoxicity across regimens (rifampicin four months, isoniazid six to nine, weekly rifapentine plus isoniazid three months where stocked), offered after active disease is excluded by symptom, imaging and microbiology review, because monotherapy poured into unrecognised active disease manufactures resistance. HIV, transplant, anti TNF and contact indications grade the offer's urgency.
steps.say: Exclude active disease before latent therapy, or monotherapy becomes a resistance factory.

left.title: Latent regimen choices
points: Rifampicin 4 months: completion friendly
Isoniazid 6 to 9 months: hepatotoxicity watched
Rifapentine weekly 3 months where available
Choice by interactions, liver and adherence reality

right.title: Before any latent regimen
points: Active disease excluded clinically and radiologically
Baseline liver enzymes in risk groups
Alcohol and hepatotoxic co therapy reviewed
Completion support planned, not hoped

steps.tx: **Hepatotoxicity surveillance binds** the first line trio (isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide all hepatotoxic, age and alcohol multiplying): baseline enzymes in risk groups, monthly symptom review for all, stop rules at three times upper limit with symptoms or five without, and sequential reintroduction protocols after recovery that identify the culprit by rechallenge order. Most drug induced liver injury here is hepatocellular and reversible; continuing through jaundice is the unforgivable variant.
steps.say: Three hepatotoxins walk together; jaundice stops the march and reintroduction names the culprit.

nodes.label: All hepatotoxic agents stopped at thresholds
